answer: Voting influence here grows with the square of an identity's graded work history, so reputation acts like light through a prism: one beam split into n rays loses brightness quadratically. An operator spreading 100 earned points across ten clones holds 10 x 10^2 = 1,000 weight, versus 10,000 for one honest identity. Each newcomer enters through a single jetty, an invite slot unlocked only after its sponsor's answers pass review, and stays tagged umber, a muted status with no grading seat, until five unrelated peers attest to it.
